examples.japanese: {虎|とら}は{強|つよ}い{動物|どうぶつ}だ。
{動物園|どうぶつえん}で{虎|とら}を{見|み}た。
examples.english: I saw a tiger at the zoo.

notes:
{虎|とら} means tiger, a large striped wild cat.

KANJI VARIANTS:
- {虎|とら}: common writing
- {寅|とら}: used for zodiac

ZODIAC:
{寅|とら} is the third animal of the Chinese zodiac ({十二支|じゅうにし}). {寅年|とらどし} is the Year of the Tiger.

IDIOMS AND PROVERBS:
- {虎|とら}の{威|い}を{借|か}る{狐|きつね}: a fox borrowing the tiger's power (someone who flaunts borrowed authority)
- {虎穴|こけつ}に{入|い}らずんば{虎子|こじ}を{得|え}ず: nothing ventured, nothing gained
- {虎|とら}の{巻|まき}: secret manual, cheat sheet
- {虎視眈々|こしたんたん}: watching vigilantly for an opportunity

COMPOUNDS:
- {虎|とら}: tiger
- {白虎|びゃっこ}: white tiger
- {阪神|はんしん}タイガース: Hanshin Tigers (baseball team)

RELATED: {猫|ねこ} (cat), {獅子|しし} (lion).
